description: Rothco's Canvas Extended Stay Travel Duffle Bag offers versatile carrying options, serving as both a duffle bag and a backpack. Crafted from heavyweight cotton canvas with leather accents, the convertible backpack ensures long-lasting durability for extended travels. This travel bag features a spacious main compartment with a zippered flap top and side access zipper, providing easy access to your belongings. Additionally, the canvas duffle bag includes 2 large side zippered pockets, as well as front and back zippered pockets with flap and push-button buckle closures for organizing smaller items securely. For added convenience, the bag boasts hideaway padded backpack straps, allowing you to convert it into a backpack effortlessly. It also includes adjustable and detachable shoulder straps, offering customizable carrying options based on your preference. Finished with antique brass hardware, this travel duffle bag exudes a timeless aesthetic while providing functionality for all your travel needs. Whether you're embarking on a weekend getaway or an extended journey, this versatile bag ensures you're prepared for any adventure. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
